invariants.rationale: writeMetadata must be non-null to call getWriteStatuses.
The method always returns a new TableWriteStats object.
Each WriteStatus from writeMetadata is mapped to a stat object in the resulting TableWriteStats.
Each stat in the result should not be null since WriteStatus#getStat should return a valid object for each status.
The stats in the result are exactly those generated by applying getStat to all WriteStatuses.
